Uniqueness of the College
With the agricultural context in the country losing its significance day by day, Palar Agricultural College aims at educating young minds to learn and implement latest techniques in farming and agriculture.
State of art infrastructure, facilities, labs.
Latest tools, equipment & technology to enlighten students
Highly qualified staff including research guides & professors.
Vast college campus to accommodate 5000 students.
Chairman Message
Palar Agricultural College was established in the year 2017 under the aegis of RS Educational and Charitable trust with the aim to impart quality education to the budding scientist of Agriculture. Choosing a college is one the most important decisions that you ever make.
Learn more
Principal's Message
Dear Students, Faculty and Staff, 
As the Principal of Palar Agricultural College, it is with immense pride and pleasure that I extend a warm welcome to all of you to our esteemed institution. Since our establishment in 2017, we have been dedicated to nurturing young minds and fostering a passion for agriculture.
